semantic.justification: Browser delivery binding loads the actual pinned libxml2 2.15.3 C implementation compiled to WASM. Source checksum matches LibreOffice download.lst; the generated loader exports consumed native APIs and C struct accessors, and Clang generates actual C function signatures. Realm-local initialization and byte buffers do not introduce a JavaScript DOM or alternate native allocator. Focused owner tests and native Node/Chromium Worker/main-realm probes cover dependency initialization, actual attribute child trees, shared namespaces, text coalescing, clone document ownership and XML IO. Concrete UNO DOM owners, dispatcher coverage, metadata and complete DOCX/XLSX file/UI parity remain unverified.
